Full Rundown

Venue by venue

1 Blue Note SP — Avery*Sunshine Soul · R&B · Gospel · Grammy Avery*Sunshine brings her Grammy-winning soul to the Blue Note SP for two sessions tonight — and if you missed her at the Blue Note Rio on Wednesday, this is the second chance. Born Denise White in Chester, Pennsylvania, she began playing piano at eight, studied classical and jazz through her teens, became a gospel choir director, joined Tyler Perry’s productions, performed at Obama’s inauguration, opened for B.B. King, hit number one on Billboard with “Call My Name,” and won the 2025 Grammy for Best Progressive R&B Album with “So Glad to Know You.” Her live show is famous for its energy: candid stage banter, humorous storytelling between songs, and a voice that reviewers have described as smooth and powerful enough to give goosebumps. She plays her own piano. Her husband and creative partner Dana “BigDane” Johnson co-produces. The sound spans neo-soul, gospel, R&B and jazz — all of it uplifting, all of it driven by the conviction that music should satisfy the soul. Tonight at 8 pm and 10:30 pm on the Conjunto Nacional’s second floor, above Av. Paulista, she does exactly that. Fri 8 pm + 10:30 pm · Eventim Av. Paulista, 2073 – Conjunto Nacional, 2º andar Grammy 2025 · Metro Consolação · Double session

2 D-Edge Freak Chic — Friday from Midnight Electronic · House · Friday Twenty-four hours after the D-Edge Festival shook Komplexo Tempo with 50+ artists across five stages, the club on Av. Auro Soares de Moura Andrade returns to its regular Friday programming. Freak Chic is the Friday-night party — the house-leaning counterpart to Thursday’s Moving and Saturday’s NAVE. From midnight. Check @dedgeclub for tonight’s specific lineup — the post-festival Friday Freak Chic often carries residual energy from the festival week, with surprise guests and extended sets. The LED-panel walls, the two pistas, the rooftop terrace for the sunrise crowd — the same D-Edge infrastructure that hosted last night’s festival returns to its weekly format. The question tonight is not whether to go to D-Edge, but whether your legs have recovered from last night. Fri from midnight · Ingresse/Blueticket Av. Auro Soares de Moura Andrade, 141 – Barra Funda @dedgeclub for lineup · Post-festival Friday

3 Ó do Borogodó — Peak Friday Samba · Peak · Pinheiros Friday at the Borogodó rivals Saturday for intensity. The room on Rua Horácio Lane fills from the moment doors open at 10 pm, and by 11 the samba roda is at full power — louder, faster, more physical than any other night of the week except Saturday. The crowd is a Friday mix: the Pinheiros dinner crowd migrating from Mourato Coelho, the post-work contingent who have been building toward this since Monday, visitors who found the Borogodó in a guidebook and are about to discover that the best samba in São Paulo happens in a plain room in Pinheiros with no decoration and no pretence. Five hours to 3 am. Arrive before 10:30 for a table. After that: standing, dancing, the beer from the counter, the music from the roda, the night at its most unfiltered. Fri 10 pm–3 am · Cover ~R$30 R. Horácio Lane, 21 – Pinheiros Metro Faria Lima · Arrive before 10:30

4 Casa de Francisca — Friday Full Programme Three Stages · Curated · Peak Friday at the Casa is when all three stages of the Palacete Teresa run at peak: the Salão opens at 10 pm with the week’s marquee seated show, the Porão runs its own underground programme from 10 pm, and the Largo terrace has been running free DJs since 7 pm. Check casadefrancisca.art.br/novo/programacao for tonight’s specific acts. Friday is when the Casa draws its biggest crowd — the Largo spills onto the sidewalk, the Porão fills to standing-room capacity, and the Salão runs to 1 am. The transition from Largo (free, outdoor, social) to Salão or Porão (ticketed, focused, musical) is the Friday Casa de Francisca experience — the building as a three-stage journey through a single evening. Fri Salão 10 pm · Porão 10 pm · Largo free 7 pm R. Quintino Bocaiúva, 22 – Sé Metro Sé · Check programação · Peak Friday

5 Bar Brahma Centro — Friday Samba Samba · MPB · Peak Friday Friday at Bar Brahma is the busiest night alongside Saturday — the art deco room at São João and Ipiranga at its loudest and most crowded, the live samba playing to a Friday audience that has been waiting all week. For visitors combining the Casa de Francisca (Sé) with Bar Brahma (Centro), Friday is the definitive Centro pairing: Largo free DJs at 7, dinner at Brahma at 8, back to the Palacete Teresa by 10 for the Salão or Porão show. The samba at Brahma is louder on Fridays. The chopp moves faster. The room feels like 1948 and 2026 at the same time. Fri 11 am–1 am · Live samba · Peak Av. São João, 677 – Centro Metro República · Walk from Casa de Francisca

One way to do it

The Pinheiros dinner circuit at its busiest — reserve if possible. 2 10:00 pm — Ó do Borogodó or Avery*Sunshine 10:30 Two parallel options. Borogodó for peak Friday samba from 10 pm. Or metro to Consolação for Avery*Sunshine’s second session at 10:30. Both are the best of São Paulo. 3 Midnight — D-Edge Freak Chic Ride-hailing from Pinheiros or Paulista to Barra Funda. Freak Chic opens at midnight. The post-festival Friday at the club. Both pistas. Rooftop for sunrise. 4 Sunrise — or home from the Borogodó at 3 am D-Edge runs to sunrise. The Borogodó closes at 3 am. Tomorrow: D-Edge NAVE Saturday flagship. Theo Bial + Roberto Menescal “A Nossa Bossa Nova” at Blue Note SP. DE26 Rio in the other city. The weekend continues.

05

Still Going After 22h

Late night

Friday after 10 pm is when São Paulo splits into its parallel cities. D-Edge Freak Chic runs from midnight to sunrise. Ó do Borogodó runs to 3 am. Casa de Francisca Salão and Porão run through 1 am. World.title: Rio de Janeiro Nightlife Guide for Friday, April 3, 2026
World.content:
The Rio Times · RT Nightlife Desk Peak Friday — the fullest night of the Rio de Janeiro nightlife week · Blue Note Rio double session at 8 pm and 10:30 pm (check bluenoterio.com.br) · Rio Scenarium packed to 2 am+ · Carioca da Gema full flight · Beco do Rato to 2 am · Pedra do Sal Friday roda · 30 °C cloudless night · DE26 Rio tomorrow

01

Tonight’s Vibe Menu

Friday is the biggest night of the Rio de Janeiro nightlife week. Every venue is open. Every venue is at peak energy. The entire circuit — from the Blue Note in Copacabana to the Lapa triangle to the Pedra do Sal in Saúde — runs simultaneously at full power. The Blue Note Rio runs its Friday double session at 8 pm and 10:30 pm — check bluenoterio.com.br for tonight’s headliner as the April programme enters its first weekend. The calçadão Happy Hour from 5 pm is free. In Lapa, the full circuit is at maximum: Rio Scenarium is packed — Friday is when the three-storey casarão on Rua do Lavradio earns its global reputation, with the main-stage samba louder, the gafieira floor heaving, the seven antique-filled environments across three floors at capacity. Cover pushes to R$40–60. Arrive before 8 pm or book via Sympla. Carioca da Gema runs its Happy Hour from 6:30 pm free and the main show at 8:30 pm to a Friday crowd that is the largest and most physical of the week. Beco do Rato runs 6 pm to 2 am — the longest night. Pedra do Sal runs its less-famous Friday roda from around 6 pm in Saúde — a different organiser from Monday, a different energy, but the same carved stone staircase and the same Pequena África neighbourhood. This is part of The Rio Times’ daily Rio de Janeiro nightlife coverage for expats and visitors. Sunny — 30 °C, 15 % rain chance. A hot, cloudless Friday night. No jacket, no umbrella. The city at its warmest and most alive.

Fast scan

1 Blue Note Rio — Friday Double Session 8 pm + 10:30 pm · Av. Atlântica, 1910 – Copacabana · Check bluenoterio.com.br · Eventim · HH from 5 pm 2 Rio Scenarium — Peak Friday 7 pm–2 am+ · R. do Lavradio, 20 – Centro · Cover ~R$40–60 · Sympla · Metro Carioca · Book ahead 3 Carioca da Gema — Friday Samba Doors 7:30 pm · Show 8:30 pm · Av. 03

Full Rundown

Venue by venue

1 Blue Note Rio — Friday Double Session Jazz · MPB · Peak Friday Friday is the Blue Note’s biggest night alongside Saturday — double session at 8 pm and 10:30 pm, the room at its most charged, the audience at its most anticipatory. This week the Blue Note opened April with back-to-back international acts — Grammy winner Avery*Sunshine on Wednesday and NYC’s Sam Greenfield on Thursday — and the Friday headliner continues the momentum. Check bluenoterio.com.br for tonight’s specific artist and tickets via Eventim. The calçadão Happy Hour runs from 5 pm with free entry to the piano bar and the Copacabana oceanfront — on a 30 °C cloudless Friday, the calçadão is at its absolute best. Friday is also the night when the Copacabana-to-Lapa route is most dramatic: show at 8, metro to Lapa by 10, the Scenarium peaking at 11. Two worlds in one evening. Fri 8 pm + 10:30 pm · Check bluenoterio.com.br Av. Atlântica, 1910 – Copacabana HH from 5 pm free · Eventim · Peak Friday

2 Rio Scenarium — Peak Friday Samba · Gafieira · Peak Friday is when the Scenarium earns its global reputation. The three-storey casarão on Rua do Lavradio fills completely: the main-stage samba is louder, the gafieira dance floor is packed, the seven antique-filled environments across three floors throb with the kind of energy that only a Friday crowd in a 19th-century building can generate. The cover pushes to R$40–60. Arrive before 8 pm for a table — after 9 pm you are standing. Advance booking through Sympla is advisable. Friday is also the night when the Scenarium’s kitchen is most active: the petiscos come fast, the bar runs long, and the venue pushes past 2 am. If you have one night in Lapa this week, this is it. Fri 7 pm–2 am+ · Cover ~R$40–60 · Sympla R. do Lavradio, 20 – Centro Book ahead · Arrive before 8 pm for table

3 Carioca da Gema — Friday Night Samba · MPB · Full Friday at the Gema is the biggest night of its weekly run. The Happy Hour still applies — free entry from 6:30 pm, dose dupla caipirinha, Original R$12.99, half-price petiscos — but arrive early because the three-room casarão on Mem de Sá fills by 9 pm. The main show at 8:30 pm plays to a crowd that’s been building energy through two rounds of caipirinhas, and the atmosphere is distinctly different from Tuesday or Wednesday: louder, hotter, more physical. Friday is also the best night to combine the Gema with the Scenarium — the two-venue Lapa crawl that is the definitive Friday-night experience in the city. Fri doors 7:30 pm · Show 8:30 pm Av. Mem de Sá, 79 – Lapa HH free 6:30–8:30 · Arrive early Friday

4 Beco do Rato — Friday to 2 am Samba · Botequim · Late Friday is the longest night at the Beco — 6 pm to 2 am, eight hours of samba de raiz with no cover. The alleyway on Rua Joaquim Silva transforms after 10 pm on Fridays: the crowd spills out of the bar, the sound carries down the street, and the energy approaches the outdoor party atmosphere that makes Lapa famous. On a Friday when both Rio Scenarium and Carioca da Gema are packed and charging covers, the Beco offers the free alternative with the same Lapa electricity. The samba is more raw, the crowd more local, the beer colder for the price. The natural Friday crawl: Gema HH at 6:30, Beco at 9, Scenarium at 11, back to the Beco for the 1 am set. Fri 6 pm–2 am · No cover R. Joaquim Silva, 11 – Lapa Samba de raiz · The longest night

5 Pedra do Sal — Friday Roda Samba · Street · Free The Monday roda at Pedra do Sal is the famous one, but the Friday roda is its less-known counterpart: a different organising group, a different energy, a different crowd. The Friday session at the birthplace of carioca samba in Saúde runs from around 6 pm, outdoor and free. It is not as large or as choreographed as the Monday event, which makes it more intimate and less tourist-heavy. The carved stone staircase, the Pequena África neighbourhood, the sound of samba floating through the narrow streets — all of that is the same. On a 30 °C evening, the outdoor setting is at its best. Ride-hailing for departure. VLT Parada dos Museus is the nearest stop. The best double-venue route: Pedra do Sal from 6 pm, ride-hailing to Lapa by 9 pm when the Scenarium is in full swing. Fri from ~6 pm · Free · Outdoor Largo João da Baiana – Saúde Different organiser from Monday · Intimate

04

Suggested Route

One way to do it

1 5:00 pm — Blue Note Rio calçadão Happy Hour Free entry, piano bar, Copacabana oceanfront. 30 °C, cloudless. The calçadão is at its annual best tonight. The finest Friday HH setting in Rio. 2 8:00 pm — Blue Note Friday show session 1 The April Friday headliner. Double session. Check bluenoterio.com.br for tonight’s artist. The room is at peak Friday energy. 3 10:00 pm — Cross to Lapa Metro Cardeal Arcoverde → Cinelândia, 20 min. The Scenarium is peaking. The Gema main show is in full flight. The Beco runs to 2 am. All within a five-minute walk. 4 Late — Nova Capela or the Beco’s 1 am set Nova Capela kitchen late. Beco samba until 2 am. Tomorrow: Feijoada Raiz on the Blue Note calçadão + Amigos da Cacilda brass band. Scenarium peak Saturday. DE26 Rio — D-Edge comes to the city.

05

Still Going After 22h

Late night

Friday after 10 pm is the fullest the circuit gets all week. Rio Scenarium pushes past 2 am. Beco do Rato runs to 2 am. Carioca da Gema’s main show finishes around 11 pm but the bar stays open.
